title: Seattle Brunch Cruise
includes: Prosecco or sparkling cider toast upon boarding
Lake Washington (cruising on Lake Washington is subject to boat traffic and weather)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Attire: At the discretion of each customer. A sweater or light jacket is recommended for cooler weather when viewing from the outdoor decks.
Vegan or vegetarian upon request (Morning Star sausage, Just Egg) when booking
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Indulge in a delightful brunch on the water with your Brunch Cruise! This relaxing cruise combines delicious food with unbeatable views of Seattle’s iconic skyline, sparkling waters, and scenic surroundings. Sip mimosas, savor freshly prepared brunch dishes, and relax with friends and family as you float through the lakes. With a variety of breakfast favorites, this cruise is the perfect way to spend your weekend—whether you’re celebrating something special or just in the mood for a unique brunch experience in Seattle.
